# The dairy fat paradox: Whole dairy products may be healthier than we thought
## → What this article adds:
A glass of whole milk contains 5 g saturated fatty acid, or in other words, 20% of the daily amount recommended by the 2015 Dietary Guidelines for Americans ( [1](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6014779/#R1)).

Mozaffarian et al. found that higher trans-palmitoleate levels were associated with slightly lower adiposity, triglyceride, C-reactive protein, and insulin resistance.

# Is Whole Milk Better Than Low Fat and Skim Milk?
Recent studies suggest that skim milk might not always be the best health-promoting choice.

## Different types of dairy milk: Whole, low fat, and skim
- **whole milk:** 3.25% milk fat
- **skim:** less than 0.5% milk fat

The more fat a cup of milk has in it, the higher its omega-3 content ([7Trusted Source](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK564314/)[Trusted Source](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK564314/)).

Additionally, studies have shown that **organic whole milk** contains an even higher amount of **omega-3s** than regular whole milk.

Whole milk contains more fat and calories than skim milk.

## Whole milk and weight management
According to one 2016 study of 18,438 women, increased intake of full-fat dairy products was linked to a lower risk of weight gain over an 11-year period.

Another study from 2017 found that dairy fat intake was not linked to a higher risk of weight gain, heart disease, or type 2 diabetes ([28Trusted Source](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC6014779/)).

Similarly, one 2020 review of 29 studies concluded that full fat dairy consumption was not associated with weight gain or fat gain in children ([29Trusted Source](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC7360438/)).

In studies that look at only high fat dairy products, like whole milk, there is a pretty consistent connection between full fat dairy and lower body weight, suggesting that whole milk can be a great addition to a **well-rounded, nutrient-dense diet** and may help you maintain a **moderate weight**.

While more research needs to be done, there is not much evidence that drinking whole milk instead of skim causes weight gain.

## The advantage of choosing skim milk
Skim milk provides approximately the same amount of protein and calcium as whole milk but contains fewer calories.

web.title: Is low-fat or full-fat the better choice for dairy products? - Harvard Health
web.description:
## The Diet Review:
For context, one cup of whole milk has 4.5 grams of saturated fat.

## Is the landscape changing?
Recent research is beginning to suggest that at least some types of full-fat dairy may not be as concerning as once thought.

A 2025 review of data, published in the _American Journal of Clinical Nutrition,_ stated that dairy consumption of any kind - full-fat, low-fat, fat-free - has not been associated with cardiovascular disease risk.

## Harvard Health Publishing’s 6-Week Plan for Healthy Eating
- There are no consistent differences in outcomes when comparing full-fat dairy intake to low-fat dairy intake.
- Some studies suggest that full-fat milk - but not other dairy products - is associated with slightly higher cardiovascular disease risk.

About 38% of the time, dairy consumption was linked to more favorable outcomes; 4% of the time, it was linked to unfavorable outcomes.

However, a recent study including data from more than 400,000 adults found that people who ate a lot of dairy fat were at increased risk of death from cardiovascular disease, compared with those who ate little to no dairy fat.
